'''Bats''' are monsters found in [[Daemonheim]], on [[abandoned floors|abandoned]], [[furnished floors|furnished]], and [[occult floors]]. They are generally low-levelled, and don't hit very high. Subsequently, they are often given the lowest priority in [[guardian door]] rooms.

As the bats within Daemonheim use [[melee]], they are weak to [[magic]]. However, the spell weakness will vary between each individual bat (ie: one bat will be weak to [[Earth spells]], while the next will be weak to [[Air spells]].)
